'''Suria space station'''<ref name="DB" /> was a [[space station]] that orbited the [[planet]] [[Suria]]<ref name="Bad" /> in the [[Suria system]], in the [[Kira sector]] of the [[Expansion Region]].<ref name="Appendix" /> It was a common stop for [[Mercenary|mercenaries]], [[assassin]]s,<ref name="DB" /> and [[bounty hunter]]s. It included a [[cantina]] named [[Tanda's Cantina]], managed by a [[Unidentified modified DUM-series pit droid|DUM-series pit droid]] and guarded by two [[Vanguard Axis]] droids. The station had several [[hangar]]s in its equator region.<ref name="Bad" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|308}}</ref> [[Fennec Shand]] was based on the space station and stored her ship, the ''[[Outcast]]'', in one of its hangars.<ref name="Bad" />

{{Station-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' placed Suria in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] in grid square P-17, along the route<ref name="CLNE">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> known as the [[Five Veils Route]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> However, the "[[Star Systems of the Galaxy]]" appendix instead moved the Suria system to the Expansion Region in grid square N-16,<ref name="Appendix" /> which was the system's location in Legends.<ref name="TEA" /> The second version of the appendix, released on [[October 13]] of that year, restored Suria's placement in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Substack-2">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/star-wars-galaxy-map-update|text=Star Wars Galaxy Map Update|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-10-13}}</ref>
